name: casual
title: Casual SFX Pack
description: Juicy sound effects for hyper-casual and casual mobile web games. Designed to pair with the Super Casual UI Kit.
style: Modern mobile casual game audio: clean, bright, punchy, lightly processed. Not retro/8-bit, not cinematic/orchestral. Mono, dry (no long reverb tails), normalized to -1 dBFS peak.

ui.tap.whenToUse: The player taps any button. The single most-used sound in the game.
ui.tap.prompt: Short soft UI button tap for a mobile puzzle game, single clean woody pop with a light bright click on top, no reverb, no tail, 0.1 seconds

ui.back.whenToUse: Back, close or cancel. The darker twin of ui.tap.
ui.back.prompt: Short soft UI back button sound for a mobile game, muted low woody pop, slightly descending pitch, no reverb, 0.12 seconds

ui.whoosh.whenToUse: A popup opens or a screen slides in. Also good for cards dealing and panels sliding.
ui.whoosh.prompt: Quick soft air whoosh for a mobile game popup opening, filtered noise sweep rising then settling, smooth and clean, no reverb tail, 0.3 seconds

ui.toggle.whenToUse: A switch, checkbox or tab changes state.
ui.toggle.prompt: Tiny crisp UI switch toggle click for a mobile game settings menu, single short plastic tick with a small pitch bump, dry, 0.08 seconds

ui.error.whenToUse: The action is not allowed: not enough coins, locked level, wrong move.
ui.error.prompt: Gentle friendly error sound for a casual mobile game, two soft descending muted tones, discouraging but not harsh or alarming, dry, 0.3 seconds

ui.tick.whenToUse: Countdown timer in its warning seconds, or a counter ticking up.
ui.tick.prompt: Short clean clock tick for a mobile game countdown timer, single dry wooden tick with slight pitch, tense but light, 0.06 seconds

coin.collect.whenToUse: One coin, gem or pickup is collected. Plays many times in a row, so it is deliberately short.
coin.collect.prompt: Bright short coin pickup chime for a casual mobile game, small metallic bell ping with a quick upward pitch, clean and sweet, no reverb tail, 0.15 seconds

coin.pile.whenToUse: A burst of coins flies to the counter, or the reward total counts up.
coin.pile.prompt: Cascade of coins landing in a pile for a mobile game reward, many bright metallic tinkles overlapping in a rising shimmer, cheerful, clean, 0.9 seconds

reward.star.whenToUse: One star fills on a level-complete screen. Play it once per star with a rising pitch.
reward.star.prompt: Magical star earned chime for a mobile game level complete screen, bright glassy bell with a sparkle shimmer, rising, warm and rewarding, 0.4 seconds

reward.claim.whenToUse: The player claims a reward, buys an item, or opens a gift.
reward.claim.prompt: Satisfying reward claimed sound for a casual mobile game, bright three note rising sparkle with a soft magical shimmer, generous and happy, 0.7 seconds

reward.chest.whenToUse: A chest, box or crate opens and reveals its contents.
reward.chest.prompt: Treasure chest opening for a casual mobile game, wooden creak and metal latch click then a magical rising sparkle reveal with golden shimmer, 1.2 seconds

state.win.whenToUse: The level is completed. Plays once on the Success screen.
state.win.prompt: Short happy level complete fanfare for a casual mobile game, bright playful ascending melody on marimba and bells with a light cheerful sparkle ending, no orchestra, 1.5 seconds

state.lose.whenToUse: The level is failed. Plays once on the Fail screen.
state.lose.prompt: Gentle level failed sound for a casual mobile game, soft descending three note woodwind sigh, disappointed but friendly and encouraging, not dark or scary, 1.2 seconds

feedback.powerup.whenToUse: A booster, power-up or upgrade activates.
feedback.powerup.prompt: Power up activation for a casual mobile game, fast rising bubbly arpeggio with a bright energetic swell, positive and punchy, 0.6 seconds
